title: 319/100 is strictly below 19^10, and so is this inverse 2-norm (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `19^10 = 6131066257801`, which is strictly greater than `319/100`.
- The normalized Schur inverse on `0,1,2,7,8,9` has 2-norm strictly below `319/100`, so that 2-norm is strictly below `p^10`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one normalized section, not the note's all-size 2-norm envelope.
